summary: Fix startup being blocked by empty saved-data folders or a verified retained profile whose location record is missing.

items.text: Open normally when pre-existing empty CloudInlet folders would previously trigger an unrecognized-profile migration error. Preserve existing CloudBay accounts when the other profile location contains only empty folders.

Recover a missing location record for a single retained CloudInlet profile after verifying its settings, encrypted accounts and databases. Keep conflicting profiles, corrupt records, active installers and orphaned migration evidence protected from automatic adoption.
Show clearer startup failure details with affected profile paths, a Copy details button and direct support guidance instead of assuming every startup failure is an unfinished migration.
Retain Microsoft Store build logs separately from the validated installer publication inventory.

installationNotes: This is a maintenance update to the existing non-modular app. Backblaze B2 and OneDrive remain built in; no connector packs are required.
Microsoft Store installations receive updates through Microsoft Store after approval and rollout. EXE and MSI installations keep their existing update channel and build flavor.

Keep saved-data folders and recovery records intact. This update does not merge conflicting profiles, reset accounts or remove personal files. GitHub source archives are source code, not app installers.

items: The original startup error was reproduced in five isolated pre-fix cases. The fixed Release solution built with zero warnings or errors; 52 focused routing and recovery cases, 1,299 hosted-compatible regression cases and 141 release-script assertions passed locally.

The local focused checks include native profile routing, protected accounts, interrupted migration, hidden files, conflicting data, active installers and byte-preservation checks. The broader run excludes LiveProvider and other Native-named desktop tests.
The affected customer's machine and new production Store delivery have not been tested. This maintenance release does not claim new live-provider or full desktop acceptance coverage.

storeStatus: CloudInlet is available in Microsoft Store. Version 1.2.2 requires a new Microsoft certification and rollout; the included unsigned MSIX is not a trusted Store installer.
